Other items are equations in text (no lab activity): halogen+H2, HX+H2O, carbonates+acid, ion formation. Ionization/electron-gain equations are theory (card). Book does not show Ca(OH)2/CO2 or bicarbonate equations; formulas inferred from named substances. Book does not give colours of chemicals except CO2 (no colour). The 'একক কাজ' items (pp.73,75) and model questions (pp.80-81) are theory, not experiments. Periodic-table pages 62-63 show element names/symbols only (no reactions).
